bio: Carmela was baptized on 21 August 1801, daughter of Alessio Moraca and Saveria Sacco. Her entry survives only in a copy made after the original pages fell out of the register in 1821 ([R4-S1]). She married Luigi Colosimo on 29 January 1818 ([R4-S2]) and was buried on 29 March 1864 ([R4-S3]).
